Restored to the bytes the .201 dev lane actually applied (content sha c1691130, commit 559ee461a, applied 2026-08-22 20:09:18+00). Commit 7de798a4a had rewritten this applied file in place with 46 lines of reconciliation and five SET NOT NULL that no database ever ran. The delta is re-expressed additively in 0002, minus name/provider which 0001 deliberately relaxes.

CI shape reconciliation requires 0000 to include explicit ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS guards after CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS; the same idempotent reconciliation is expressed additively in 0001 for already-applied deployments.
